name: 中值滤波检测
description: 检测 traces of median filtering applied to suppress JPEG 伪影 and hide 篡改 evidence.
algorithm: Median Filtered Image Forensics via First-Digit Analysis
mechanism: 分析 pixel value 分布s 以检测 the smoothing 伪影 characteristic of median filtering. Median filtering removes high-frequency noise but leaves detectable traces in the 直方图 and pixel co-occurrence matrices.
parameters: Window sizes: 3×3, 5×5, 7×7; Feature: 直方图 bin 分析, pixel auto相关性, streak 分析
source: Kirchner, M. & Fridrich, J. (2010) — On Detection of Median Filtering in Digital Images, SPIE Electronic Imaging
useCase: Detecting anti-取证 median filtering used to conceal 图像篡改 or AI generation traces

references.title: Kirchner, M. & Fridrich, J. (2010) — On Detection of Median Filtering in Digital Images, SPIE Electronic Imaging

strengths:
• Robust 检测 of median filtering traces
• Works 跨 different window sizes
• Effective anti-取证 countermeasure
• Low 误报 rate
limitations:
• Cannot detect very light filtering
• May confuse with other smoothing filters
• Requires sufficient image 分辨率
• Performance degrades with heavy JPEG压缩
